items.subject: Re: PPA term sheet - revised pricing
items.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We can live with the 12 year term but the 74/MWh floor is still above what finance signed off on (they said 71). Can you rework the sensitivity table before Thursday's board pre-read?

Also, I said I'd send the grid-connection study last week - it's slipping, sorry. Will land by Mar 6.

Maya

> On Feb 24, Sam Reyes wrote:
> Revised pricing attached, floor at 74/MWh.

--
Maya Okafor | Head of Commercial | Brightmoor Renewables
This email may contain confidential information.
